'''''Candra''''' was one of three [[Airship/Legends|airships]] led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Edell Vrai]] on an exploratory expedition from the continent [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] across the [[Western Sea (Kesh)|Western Sea]] to [[Alanciar]]. It was named in honor of [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] member [[Candra Kitai]].
